description: Opens the one group text thread for 2 to 9 contacts who each have a phone, as the inbox's New conversation with several people checked does (an existing group for the same people is reused). Nothing is sent; texting it is send_conversational_message, which shows your person the words first. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: start_group_text
title: Open a group text thread
